Our firm

Building the infrastructure for the next generation of business ownership.

Legacy Search is a founder-led acquisition and transaction advisory platform. We connect the people who built a business with those ready to lead its next chapter.

“Great businesses deserve a great next chapter.”

Our philosophy

Preserve what has been built.

An enterprise carries years of decisions, know-how and relationships. We start by understanding which of those matter most to its people.

Unlock what comes next.

We look for owners, capital and operating partners who understand what the business does well and what it could become.

Make acquisition more accessible.

A clearer path from search to transition gives entrepreneurs and established companies another way to grow.

The founder

Ango Amit

Founder, Legacy Search · BITS Pilani alumnus

Ango started Legacy Search with a question. What if the next generation of entrepreneurs didn't always have to start from zero?

For a family considering succession, a business carries relationships, jobs and hard-won operating knowledge. Legacy Search brings owners, entrepreneurs and capital together around the future of that enterprise.
